title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Title: Accounts Assistant

Location: Wolverhampton

Salary: £26,500 - £27,000

Top of the range will be offered to a candidate with at least 1 year of experience in Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

Join a growing law firm with locations in Wolverhampton and Birmingham as an Accounts Assistant. This role is ideal for someone with experience in accounts who can support with billing, reconciliations, payments, and general finance administration. This is a fantastic opportunity to become a key player in the day-to-day operations of the finance function in a supportive and professional environment. This position is particularly suitable for someone early in their career, as the company is eager to support their development and offers the opportunity to learn from experienced finance professionals

Responsibilities Will Include:
- Managing client and office account transactions.
- Processing payments, receipts and bank reconciliations.
- Supporting fee earners with billing and financial queries.
- Raising invoices and allocating incoming payments.
- Assisting with Legal Aid billing and general finance administration.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring compliance with company procedures.
- Undertake any other general ad-hoc duties as required

Ideally, You Will:
- Have a minimum of 1 year's experience within an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role.
- Be confident with bank reconciliations, payments, and invoice processing.
- Have strong communication skills and be comfortable building relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Have strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Be able to manage multiple priorities and work effectively as part of a team.

Benefits:
- Join a growing and supportive law firm with a friendly team environment.
- Gain exposure to a varied finance role with opportunities to develop your skills.
- Play an important role within the business and contribute to its continued success.
- Benefit from a stable, long-term opportunity where your contribution will be genuinely valued and they will support your career progression!

What Now?

To apply for this Accounts Assistant position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role. Interviews are being scheduled immediately, so don't hesitate to apply!

title: Service Advisor
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established, premium franchised dealership located in Wolverhampton for the position of Service Advisor. This Service Advisor role offers a strong earning potential, with an OTE of up to £37,000, and provides an excellent opportunity for an experienced automotive professional to join a prestigious dealership environment.

Benefits:
- Competitive basic salary dependent on experience
- OTE up to £37,000
- Monday to Friday working hours with one in four Saturday mornings
- Staff discount on vehicles and OEM training programmes
- 22 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Contributory pension scheme
- Ongoing training and career development
- Supportive management team in a high-performance environment

Duties:
- Greeting customers and managing service and repair enquiries efficiently
- Booking vehicles into the workshop and managing customer expectations
- Preparing accurate job cards and explaining work required clearly
- Liaising closely with technicians and the workshop controller to ensure timely completion
- Providing regular updates to customers during the service process
- Preparing and presenting accurate invoices
- Upselling additional products and services where appropriate
- Handling customer queries professionally and resolving concerns promptly
- Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction in line with manufacturer standards

Requirements:
- Proven experience as a Service Advisor within a franchised dealership
- Exceptional customer service and communication skills
- Strong organisational and administrative abilities
- Confident in discussing vehicle repairs, servicing, and additional work with customers
- Professional and personable approach
- Ability to thrive in a target-driven, busy environment
- Full UK driving licence
- Experience within a premium or prestige automotive brand is advantageous, though strong franchised dealership backgrounds are also considered

This Service Advisor role is ideal for individuals driven to succeed within a high-performance dealership setting. If you meet the requirements and are eager to progress your Service Advisor career within the automotive industry, this opportunity offers long-term growth and development.

Contact Archie Lawson, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement covering Wolverhampton and West Midlands, today to discover more about this fantastic Service Advisor opportunity.

title: Activity Co-ordinator
description:
Helping others improve and turn their lives around - there's no better feeling. It's what we do for thousands of people at more than 150 sites across the UK. Be a part of it.

Cygnet Healthcare is looking for an Activity Co-ordinator to join our team at Cygnet Raglan House.

The successful candidate will be working 42 hours per week. Working from 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM - Monday to Friday.

Cygnet Raglan House is a 25 bed high support inpatient rehabilitation (level 2) service for women. The service is designed to provide an environment that promotes mental health recovery by focusing on space, personal privacy and dignity. Women admitted to the service often come from multiple placement breakdowns, failed treatment programmes or are stepping down from secure settings.

We are dedicated to understand, stabilise and break the traumatic cycles of relapse that can impact individuals' lives. Our service has been designed with wellness in mind, providing a safe and comfortable environment that promotes efficient rehabilitation and recovery.

Your Day-to-Day at Cygnet Raglan House:

We are seeking an academically strong candidate to support and enhance the care of patients at the service by assisting the Occupational Therapist with;
- Encouraging patients to access and become involved in a variety of activities, as well as maintaining any pre-existing hobbies.
- Planning and implementing therapy programmes whilst ensuring appropriate materials are obtaine
d
- Contributing ideas, facilitating events and activities in a safe manner

We're looking for someone who has
- Experience and/or a passion for working in healthcare
- Some knowledge of Occupational Therapy
- A creative flair and the ability to work as part of an interdisciplinary team
- An awareness of recovery approaches and social inclusion (desirable)

Why Cygnet? We'll offer you
- Salary: £13.15 Per Hour
- Increasing to £13.45 Per Hour after 3 months
- Strong career progression opportunities into management roles
- Monthly reflective practice, & support with CPD opportunities
- Free meal on shift
- Expert clinical supervision & peer support
- Employee referral scheme
- Pension scheme
- Cycle to work scheme & employee discount savings.

Please note that successful candidates will be required to undergo an enhanced DBS check.

This vacancy may close before this date if a large number of applications are received.

What next?

If you care about making a difference - we want to talk to you.

Click the button to apply

title: Clerical officer
description: We are looking for a motivated and well organised administrator with excellent communication, interpersonal, IT and organisational skills with previous clerical experience in a healthcare environment to join our team. The successful candidate will be required to provide efficient, effective and comprehensive administrative support to the Community Neuro rehabilitation team and Fracture Liaison service working within a small pool of admin. You will be professional, motivated, reliable, have a flexible approach to work and have the ability to work both independently and as a part of a team. PLEASE NOTE, WE MAY CLOSE THIS VACANCY EARLY IF WE RECEIVE A HIGH NUMBERS OF APPLICATIONS.*Previous Applicants need not apply* To provide efficient, effective and comprehensive administrative support to the team leader and the Community Neuro rehabilitation Team (CNRT) and Fracture Liaison service to enable the team to work at their most effective and support in the delivery of high quality care to patients. To maintain Walsall Healthcare NHS Trust values in all aspects of the job. . Respond promptly and appropriately to external and internal telephone queries from clients, carers/relatives, members of the general public and members of the multi-disciplinary team. To refer any clinical enquires to relevant clinical teams and team leaders in a timely manner. Receive, process, and register patient referrals onto the electronic patient record system in a timely and accurate manner Provide clerical support as required and/or as assigned. Transcribe clinical documentation from the Dragon speech recognition system, ensuring accuracy, timely completion, and appropriate upload to electronic patient record systems Handle, maintain and track departmental files and/or patient records accurately, confidentially and sensitively according to approved organisational and governance standards. Manage patient record filing systems, ensuring documentation is stored accurately and readily accessible to authorised staff. Process detail relating to patients and staff promptly and accurately and in an organised manner. Entering appointment details or other job related data into computer as required Arrange meetings and attend meetings if requested to take and produce accurate minutes of the meeting, circulation of supporting papers adhering to set timescales. Work on own initiative by planning own workload and/or tasks arranging own diary to resolve conflicting appointments to ensure needs of the service are met Requesting stationary and other consumables relevant to local base using e-procurement system and/or non stock in line with financial standing regulations and maintain adequate stock levels, receiving deliveries ensuring that they are checked, logged and forwarded to the appropriate staff member. Reporting of faults i.e. general maintenance issues.
